 New Rumors on Arch Manning vs. KJ Lacey Jr.'s QB1 Battle After Texas' Loss to Florida
 Joseph Zucker Oct 19, 2026 Texas is sticking with Arch Manning as the starting quarterback but could be laying the groundwork for an eventual change under center.
 ESPN's Pete Thamel reported Monday that Karle "KJ" Lacey Jr. is expected to receive "an uptick in first-team quarterback reps."
 Lacey, a 4-star recruit in the 2025 class, thrown nine passes for 70 yards through his two seasons on the Longhorns.
